candidates.recoverability: not shown necessary -- ordinary R already achieves closure (existence proven)

the_N5_finding.interpretation: The ratio itself is increasing (4 -> 5.75 -> 10.04), i.e. the family is growing FASTER than exponentially in the tested range, not slowing toward a plateau. This is real, exhaustive (not sampled) data for N<=5, computed via a direct bipartite-subset construction rather than full brute-force enumeration of all 2^25 relations (judged infeasible in run 14; the bipartite-only subset construction used here is tractable and exhaustive over exactly the relevant subset). This significantly strengthens (without proving for all N) the case that Outcome G (non-unique, non-converging family) is the correct final classification for the seed layer, rather than eventual uniqueness at some larger N.
the_N5_finding.still_zero_symmetric_overlap: Confirmed again at N=5: 0/231 of the corrected candidates are symmetric, extending the pattern from N=2,3,4 (0/1, 0/4, 0/23). This is now a 4-point-confirmed pattern, still not proven in general, still reported as OPEN rather than asserted as a theorem.
